goal: Queue uses integer priority (smaller first), with FIFO order for ties. Scheduling an existing key replaces its pending item; cancellation removes it. Stale heap entries must never run and must not consume a later replacement. pop returns (key, value), or None when empty. Inspect the code, repair the implementation, and run the tests. Do not modify tests.
